hero_title: Unit 4 · I used to be afraid of the dark.

knowledge.t: 单元概览 · 话题与课文
knowledge.d: 本单元话题是“描述过去与现在的变化”（Talk about what you used to be like）。Section A 阅读 From Shy Girl to Pop Star 讲害羞女孩 Candy Wang 靠唱歌战胜羞怯、成为流行歌星；Section B 阅读 He Studies Harder Than He Used to 讲男孩李文在父母与老师帮助下改掉坏习惯、学习进步。贯穿全单元的核心结构是 used to do。

knowledge.t: used to do：过去常常，现在不再
knowledge.d: used to + 动词原形，表示过去经常发生的动作或经常存在的状态，而现在已不再如此。例：He used to be short, but now he is tall.（他过去很矮，现在高了。）She used to be afraid of the dark, but now she isn't.（她过去怕黑，现在不怕了。）

knowledge.t: used to 的否定、疑问与反意疑问
knowledge.d: 否定式：didn't use to（最常用）或 used not to，后仍接动词原形：She didn't use to like tests. 一般疑问式：Did + 主语 + use to + 动词原形？— Yes, sb. did. / No, sb. didn't. 例：— Did you use to be afraid of the dark? — Yes, I did. 含 used to 的陈述句变反意疑问句，附加问句用 didn't（也可用 usedn't）：He used to be short, didn't he?

knowledge.t: 三结构辨析：used to do / be used to doing / be used to do
knowledge.d: ① used to do sth 过去常常做某事（现在不做了）；② be/get used to doing sth 习惯于做某事（get used to 强调从不习惯到习惯的转变），to 是介词，后接名词或动名词；③ be used to do sth 是“被用来做某事”的被动结构，相当于 be used for doing。例：I used to get up late.（过去常晚起）He is used to getting up early.（他习惯早起）Wood is used to make paper.（木头被用来造纸。）

① be afraid of + 名词/代词：害怕某事物，如 be afraid of the dark；② be afraid of doing sth：害怕/担心（可能发生的事）；③ be afraid to do sth：因害怕而不敢做某事；④ be afraid (that) + 从句：担心……，口语中 I'm afraid (that)… 常用来委婉拒绝。答语可用 I'm afraid so. / I'm afraid not.

规则是“前肯后否、前否后肯”，附加问句的人称、时态与陈述部分保持一致。陈述部分含 never, hardly, seldom, little, few 等否定意义的词时按否定句处理，附加问句用肯定式：He is hardly ever late, is he? 陈述部分含 used to 时，附加问句用 didn't（或 usedn't）：He used to be silent in class, didn't he?
dare 作实义动词时有人称、时态变化，后接带 to 的不定式：She dares to speak in public.（她敢当众发言。）否定、疑问中也可作情态动词（无人称变化），后接动词原形：He dare not go out alone.（他不敢独自外出。）Dare she tell the truth? 另注意 didn't dare (to) do 中 to 常省略。

knowledge.t: 重点词汇 · 描述性格与外貌
knowledge.d: 描述性格：humorous（幽默的）, silent（沉默的）, outgoing（外向的）, brave（勇敢的）, active（活跃的）, quiet（安静的）, helpful（乐于助人的）, serious（严肃的）；描述外貌：tall/short, heavy/thin, straight/curly hair。派生与活用：shy（害羞的）→shyness（害羞，名词）；ton（吨）→tons of（大量的）；appear（出现）→appearance（外貌）。

used to（过去常常）, be afraid of（害怕）, from time to time（不时；偶尔）, give up（放弃；give up doing sth）, deal with（应对；处理）, in public（公开地；当众）, take up（开始从事；占用）, take pride in = be proud of（为……自豪）, in person（亲自）。如：Candy took up singing to deal with her shyness.（坎迪开始唱歌来克服她的羞怯。）

knowledge.t: 写作与地道表达 · 描述变化
knowledge.d: 写“我的变化”常用对比句型 used to…, but now…：I used to be shy, but now I'm outgoing. / I used to be afraid of speaking in public, but now I can give a speech. 注意时间状语 in the past, these days 的配合。课文地道句：Now she's not shy anymore and loves singing in front of crowds.（现在她不再害羞，而且喜欢在人群面前唱歌。）

questions.q: He ___ short and quiet, but now he is tall and outgoing.
questions.exp: 答案 A（used to be）。used to + 动词原形表示过去的状态，与 but now 呼应，说明现在已经改变；B、D 结构错误，只有 be used to doing 中的 to 后才接 doing。

questions.q: Tom ___ P.E. class in primary school, but now he enjoys sports very much.
questions.exp: 答案 A（didn't use to like）。used to 的否定式是 didn't use to + 动词原形；B 的 didn't used to 是常见错误，助动词后用原形 use。

questions.q: — ___ you use to be afraid of the dark? — Yes, I did.
questions.exp: 答案 A（Did）。used to 变一般疑问句：Did + 主语 + use to + 动词原形？答语 Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 助动词后用原形 use。

questions.q: He used to be silent in class, ___?
questions.exp: 答案 A（didn't he）。陈述部分含 used to（相当于过去时），反意疑问句的附加问句用 didn't he，也可写作 usedn't he。

questions.q: My grandfather is used to ___ up early in the morning.
questions.exp: 答案 B（getting）。be used to doing sth 意为“习惯于做某事”，to 是介词，后接动名词；若想说“过去常常早起”，句中就不应有 is。

questions.q: In this factory, wood is used to ___ paper.
questions.exp: 答案 A（make）。be used to do sth 是被动结构，意为“被用来做某事”（相当于 be used for doing）；主语 wood 无生命，只能理解为“被用来”。注意与 be used to doing（习惯于）区分。

questions.q: The little girl is afraid ___ the dark, so she sleeps with the light on.
questions.exp: 答案 A（of）。be afraid of + 名词/代词，表示“害怕某事物”：be afraid of the dark 怕黑。

questions.q: I'm afraid ___ I can't go to the party with you tonight.
questions.exp: 答案 A（that）。be afraid (that) + 从句表示“恐怕/担心……”，口语中 I'm afraid (that)… 常用来委婉拒绝；of 后接名词或动名词，to 后接动词原形，都不能带一个完整的句子。

questions.q: He dare not ___ home alone at night.
questions.exp: 答案 B（go）。此处 dare 作情态动词用于否定句：dare not + 动词原形，无人称和数的变化。He dare not go home alone. 他不敢独自回家。

questions.q: She is very brave. She dares ___ in front of the whole school.
questions.exp: 答案 A（to speak）。这里 dare 作实义动词（第三人称单数 dares），后接带 to 的不定式 dare to do；情态动词 dare（后接原形）只用于否定句和疑问句，故选 A。

questions.q: Mr. Green is very ___. He often makes us laugh in class.
questions.exp: 答案 A（humorous 幽默的）。后句“常在课堂上逗我们笑”说明他幽默；silent 沉默的、helpful 乐于助人的、brave 勇敢的均不合语境。

questions.q: After he retired, my grandfather took ___ painting as a hobby.
questions.exp: 答案 A（up）。take up 意为“开始从事（某项活动）”，take up painting 开始学画画；take off 起飞/脱下，take down 取下，take away 带走，均不合题意。

questions.q: My father gave up ___ two years ago, and he feels much healthier now.
questions.exp: 答案 B（smoking）。give up 后接名词或动名词：give up smoking 戒烟。戒掉烟后身体更健康，语义自洽。

questions.q: — How do you usually deal ___ stress? — I listen to music.
questions.exp: 答案 A（with）。deal with 意为“应对；处理”，常与疑问词 how 连用：How do you deal with…? 你怎样应对……？

questions.q: Her parents are very proud ___ her because she studies harder than before.
questions.exp: 答案 A（of）。be proud of sb. 为某人感到自豪，同义短语是 take pride in sb.；harder than before 与课文标题 He Studies Harder Than He Used to 呼应。

questions.q: He is hardly ever late for school now, ___ he?
questions.exp: 答案 A（is）。hardly 意为“几乎不”，是否定副词，陈述部分按否定句处理，反意疑问句的附加问句要用肯定式；句中有 be 动词 is，故用 is he。

flashcards.q: used to do sth 表示什么意思？
flashcards.a: 表示过去常常做某事或处于某种状态，而现在已不再如此。例：He used to be short, but now he is tall.（他过去很矮，现在高了。）

flashcards.q: used to 的否定形式怎么写？
flashcards.a: 两种：didn't use to（最常用）或 used not to，后接动词原形。例：She didn't use to be shy.（她过去不害羞。）注意不能说 didn't used to。

flashcards.q: used to 的一般疑问句和答语是什么？
flashcards.a: Did + 主语 + use to + 动词原形？— Yes, sb. did. / No, sb. didn't. 例：— Did you use to be afraid of the dark? — Yes, I did.

flashcards.q: “他过去很安静，不是吗？”反意疑问句怎么说？
flashcards.a: He used to be quiet, didn't he? 陈述部分含 used to 时，附加问句用 didn't（也可用 usedn't）。

flashcards.q: used to do / be used to doing / be used to do 如何区分？
flashcards.a: used to do 过去常常做（现在不做）；be used to doing 习惯于做某事（to 是介词）；be used to do 被用来做某事（被动结构）。例：He used to live here. / He is used to living here. / Wood is used to make paper.

flashcards.q: “我还不习惯早上六点起床”怎么表达？
flashcards.a: I'm not used to getting up at six in the morning (yet). 强调“从不习惯到习惯”的转变用 get used to：You will get used to it soon.

flashcards.q: be afraid 后面可以接哪几类结构？
flashcards.a: ① of + 名词/动名词：be afraid of the dark / of going out；② to do：be afraid to ask（不敢问）；③ that 从句：I'm afraid (that) I can't come.；答语 I'm afraid so. / I'm afraid not.

flashcards.q: dare 作实义动词和情态动词时分别怎么用？
flashcards.a: 实义动词有人称时态变化，后接带 to 的不定式：She dares to speak in public.（她敢当众发言。）否定/疑问用 didn't dare (to) do。情态动词用于否定/疑问句，无词形变化，后接动词原形：He dare not go out alone.

flashcards.q: 本单元“应对；处理”“开始从事”“放弃”“偶尔”分别是哪些短语？
flashcards.a: deal with（How do you deal with stress?）、take up（took up painting 开始学画画）、give up（give up smoking 戒烟）、from time to time（= sometimes）。另外 be proud of = take pride in 为……自豪。

flashcards.q: 写“过去与现在的变化”常用什么句型？
flashcards.a: 用 used to…, but now… 形成对比：I used to be shy, but now I'm outgoing. / She used to be afraid of the dark, but now she isn't. 可搭配 in the past / these days 等时间状语。

errors.title: used to 后误接动词的 -ing 形式
errors.wrong: He used to playing basketball when he was in middle school.（以为 used to 后接 doing）
errors.right: used to + 动词原形：He used to play basketball…，表示“过去常打篮球，现在不打了”。表示“过去常常”时 to 后不能接 doing；“习惯于做某事”才用 be used to doing。

errors.title: 否定式误写成 didn't used to
errors.wrong: She didn't used to be shy.（在 didn't 后仍用 used）
errors.right: 否定式有两种：didn't use to（常用）和 used not to，后面都接动词原形。She didn't use to be shy. = She used not to be shy. 助动词 did 后必须用原形 use。

errors.title: 把 be used to do（被动）误当成“习惯于”
errors.wrong: This machine is used to making boxes.（想说“这台机器被用来做箱子”）
errors.right: “被用来做某事”是被动结构 be used to do sth：This machine is used to make boxes. 只有当主语是能“习惯”的人且表“习惯于”时，才用 be used to doing：He is used to getting up early.

errors.title: be afraid 后错接动词原形
errors.wrong: The child is afraid of go out alone at night.（of 后接动词原形）
errors.right: of 是介词，后接名词/代词或动名词：be afraid of the dark / be afraid of going out alone。“因害怕而不敢做”用 be afraid to do：be afraid to go out。“担心……”用 that 从句：I'm afraid (that) I can't come.

errors.title: dare 的两种身份混用
errors.wrong: She didn't dared to ask the teacher questions. 或 He dares not go out at night.（把情态用法安到实义动词上）
errors.right: 作实义动词（有人称、时态变化）：She didn't dare (to) ask…；Does he dare to ask…? 作情态动词（否定/疑问，无词形变化）：He dare not go out at night. 一般现在时第三人称肯定句要用 dares to do。

errors.title: 反意疑问句：见到 hardly 仍加否定附加问句
errors.wrong: He is hardly ever late for school now, isn't he?（把 hardly 当成肯定）
errors.right: hardly, seldom, never 等词本身含否定意义，陈述部分按否定句处理，附加问句要用肯定式：He is hardly ever late, is he? 同理：She seldom goes out, does she? 含 used to 的句子附加问句用 didn't：He used to be quiet, didn't he?
